Theorem
[Local logarithmic Sobolev inequality] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0232 ↗ thm:chow-iii-log-sobolev-isoperimetric 1. ch22:22.19\group Logarithmic Sobolev

Let $\overline B(x_0,\rho )$ be compact and suppose the isoperimetric bound $\Area (\partial \Omega )^n\ge I_n\Vol (\Omega )^{n-1}$ holds for compact domains inside $B(x_0,\rho )$. Every compactly supported $C^1$ function in this ball satisfies \[ \int (2|\nabla \psi |^2-\psi ^2\log \psi ^2) +\log \! \left(\int \psi ^2\right)\int \psi ^2 \ge \left(\epsilon _n+\log (I_n/c_n)\right)\int \psi ^2, \] with the dimensional constant $\epsilon _n$ from the source normalization.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 4 to the positive superlevel sets of $\psi $, all of which remain inside the ball.
